# The formation generated by a finite group, as an intersection of formations

For a finite group $G$, the formation generated by $G$ is the class of finite groups $H$ that belong
to every formation containing $G$: the intersection of all formations containing $G$. The
definition is the same as that of [the formation generated by a finite group](formation-generated-by.md);
it is stated again for a second question on the subformations of this formation.
